info.title: TrustLens API
info.description:
**TrustLens** verifies whether an online marketplace seller is genuine or fake
and publishes a single **explainable Trust Score (0-100)** with a risk level
and the reasons behind it.

Two APIs live here:

| | Base path | Auth | Contains PII |
|---|---|---|---|
| Internal | `/api/v1` | JWT bearer + httpOnly refresh cookie | Yes (own data only) |
| Public | `/public/v1` | API key (`Authorization: Bearer tl_live_...`) | **No** |

### How the score works

AI components (EasyOCR, DeepFace, an LLM, a trained classifier) produce
*evidence with a confidence value*. A versioned, deterministic rule set turns
that evidence into points. The full per-signal breakdown is stored with every
score, so an explanation never requires recomputation - and the same inputs
always produce the same score.

Errors follow **RFC 9457** (`application/problem+json`) and always carry a
stable `code` plus the `requestId` to quote in a support request.

post.description: Creates a PENDING account and emails a verification link. Responds identically whether or not the address is already registered, so the endpoint cannot be used to enumerate users.

Response Login Api V1 Auth Login Post

post.description: Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new refresh token. Presenting an already-rotated token revokes the whole token family - a stolen token is therefore self-limiting.

schema.title: Response Refresh Api V1 Auth Refresh Post
Response Logout Api V1 Auth Logout Post
Response Logout All Api V1 Auth Logout All Post
Response Verify Email Api V1 Auth Verify Email Post

post.description: Always returns 202, whether or not the address exists. Revealing which addresses are registered would make this a phishing target list.

post.description: Returns a short-lived presigned URL. The client uploads directly to object storage; bytes never pass through the API.

post.summary: Submit CNIC and selfie for verification
post.description: Records the submission and queues OCR + face matching. Returns immediately with a job id - the AI pipeline takes 15-30 seconds and runs in the worker (ADR-0003).

get.summary: All verification checks in one call

schema.title: Response Verification Status Api V1 Verification Status Get

get.summary: Get the current trust score with its full breakdown
get.description: Returns the score, the risk band, and one entry per evaluated signal with its status, points, machine reason code and human explanation. This is the explainability contract: nothing is recomputed to answer this call.

schema.title: Response Get Trust Score Api V1 Sellers  Seller Id  Trust Score Get

get.summary: Ranked list of what would raise this score
get.description: The unearned points, ordered by how many are recoverable, each with the concrete action that would earn them.

schema.title: Response Get Improvements Api V1 Sellers  Seller Id  Trust Score Improvements Get

get.description: Scores are append-only, so history is a first-class read rather than a reconstruction.

schema.title: Response Get History Api V1 Sellers  Seller Id  Trust Score History Get

post.description: Enqueues a scoring job. Rate-limited and debounced: a burst of requests collapses into a single computation.

schema.title: Response Recompute Api V1 Sellers  Seller Id  Trust Score Recompute Post

post.description: Writes a NEW score row marked as a manual override. The computed score it replaces stays in history, a written reason is mandatory (enforced by a database CHECK), and the action is audit-logged.

schema.title: Response Override Score Api V1 Admin Sellers  Seller Id  Trust Score Override Post
Response Get Job Api V1 Jobs  Job Id  Get

get.description:
`seller_ref` may be a TrustLens id, a handle, or `{marketplaceSlug}:{yourSellerId}` if you registered the seller through this API.

Responses are cached for 5 minutes and carry an ETag. Scores change rarely, so a well-behaved client polling this endpoint costs one Redis read.

post.summary: Look up several sellers at once

get.summary: Service status and current scoring model
get.description: No authentication required. Useful as an integration smoke test.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable reason code. Switch on this, not on `text`.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How much evidence the score is based on.

unavailableSignals.title: Unavailablesignals
unavailableSignals.description: Checks that could not be performed. These are excluded from the score rather than counted as failures.
